_comment: Public corrections log, rendered on methodology.html. Every substantive data error gets an entry when fixed — no silent corrections. Fields: date fixed, what was wrong, what it should have been, how it was caught, scope of impact.

corrections.wrong: Listed the TX governorship as 'Open (Abbott term-limited)'.
corrections.right: Texas has no gubernatorial term limits. Gov. Greg Abbott is seeking a fourth term against Gina Hinojosa (D).
corrections.caught_by: Independent research pass while building the State News feature; confirmed via Texas Tribune coverage of the general-election campaign.
corrections.impact: Governors tab incumbent/open fields; race was never mis-rated (Solid R throughout).

corrections.wrong: Listed Gov. Tim Walz as running for re-election ('Post-VP run name ID boost').
corrections.right: Walz withdrew from the race on Jan 5, 2026 amid criticism of the state's handling of child-care fraud. Amy Klobuchar is the DFL-endorsed nominee.
corrections.caught_by: News collection surfaced the exit; verified across CBS, NBC, NPR, and Axios before the fix was applied.
corrections.impact: Governors tab incumbent/open/notes fields; rating unchanged (Likely D) pending forecaster moves. Stale for ~6 months — the class of error the weekly candidate-matchup verification (added July 2026) now targets.

corrections.wrong: Notes described the GOP field as unsettled/led by Burt Jones after the May 19 primary.
corrections.right: Rick Jackson (R) defeated Burt Jones in the June 16 GOP runoff; the general is Jackson (R) vs. Keisha Lance Bottoms (D).
corrections.caught_by: Weekly candidate-matchup verification subagent (Contract 3.5), 2026-07-06 run — the mechanism added July 2026 after the Abbott/Walz misses.
corrections.impact: Governors tab notes only; rating never mis-set (Toss-up throughout). Stale ~3 weeks.

corrections.wrong: Listed Janet Mills (D) as Susan Collins' challenger.
corrections.right: Mills suspended her campaign Apr 30; Graham Platner won the Jun 9 Democratic primary with >50%. Platner then withdrew Jul 10; the Democratic nominee will be chosen by a party convention by Jul 27.
corrections.impact: Senate tab challenger/notes fields; rating never mis-set (Toss-up throughout). Challenger stale ~5 weeks (Jun 9 - Jul 14).

corrections.wrong: Row still described Cassidy as 'facing an R primary challenge' from Julia Letlow, implying a pending primary
corrections.right: Cassidy lost the May 16 primary (3rd, 25%); Letlow won the Jun 27 runoff and is the R nominee vs Jamie Davis (D)
corrections.impact: Stale matchup displayed on Senate tab for ~3 weeks; rating (Solid R) unaffected
